<thought>All spectroscopic data (high‑resolution mass, 13C NMR showing nine distinct carbons including an ester carbonyl, aromatic carbons, and an ethyl fragment) are consistent with the molecule ethyl dihydroxybenzoate, which has the formula C₉H₁₀O₄ and the SMILES string CCOC(=O)c1ccc(O)cc1O.</thought>
<final_answer>CCOC(=O)c1ccc(O)cc1O</final_answer>
